* Closes abandoned sector
* Closes $conquerRace
* Closes $noConquest
* There are still territorial stations left. Handle claims.
* A claim can be created only when someone other than the territorial station's owner destroyed it.

* Normal player may claim Xenon sectors.
* UNC may claim enemy sectors during the global alliance.

* Closes $stations.s <= 1 / else-if branch.
* Closes OCV-aligned Xenon rebuild / normal logic.
* Closes territorial station check.
* Remove mission if any.

* Defense missions result in failure if the mission was accepted (mission Xenon spawned) and the station was destroyed by the player, player's mercs, or the Xenon.
* Defense missions: Xenon attackers and the Beacon.
* If this is an NPC outpost, we must transfer backlog to the nearest safe Outpost, if any.
* A Pirate was the owner of this destroyed station. Must be a Pirate base.
* Possible spawning a Pirate Warlord
* Mordan8 - Use a variable created at station creation time to prevent save-scumming.
* Add-Ons 1.12.1: Now checks the type rather than boolean.
* MordanB - Keep a timer for when you attack a pirate base. Until this timer expires, the player
* will not be able to dock at any other Pirate bases. You can't whack one and expect the others to let you dock.
* Refugee ship
